Jagan Reddy Expresses Regret Over Election Commissioner Appointment Law

Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister Y.S. Jagan Mohan Reddy has expressed regret over the YSRCP's support for the 2023 law concerning the appointment of Election Commissioners. YSRCP leaders stated that their support for the NDA government has always been "issue-based." They also indicated that the functioning of the Election Commission requires more transparency and assurances from the government. These remarks have triggered speculation about Jagan Reddy's political alignment.
